Patch 1.2.13

  • The visual effects for the Crystal Wings glider has been disabled. This is in an attempt to pinpoint a crash-to-desktop issue that has been reported by some players. We will re-enable these effects as soon as we have a fix for the issue.
  • The Daru Relic event is active for 10 days, and will end on July 20th, 2024.
  • Every day, you'll receive a letter from the Daru, starting a daily quest chain leading to the ability to make a Daru Cauldron
  • The Daru Cauldron can be used to make a variety of potions, including the Summoning Potions which will grant Mystic Daru's Lucky Gifts. These can contain a wide variety of items, may luck be on your side!
  • Read more here: https://wiki.aa-classic.com/Event_Guide:Daru_Relic
  • Some new Casino-themed furniture has been added by the team and will be available on our marketplace soon
  • Also, a Mirage Portal furniture has been added
  • A change in the Sunfish AI has been applied

== Patch 1.2.13 ==
* The visual effects for the Crystal Wings glider has been disabled. This is in an attempt to pinpoint a crash-to-desktop issue that has been reported by some players. We will re-enable these effects as soon as we have a fix for the issue.
* The Daru Relic event is active for 10 days, and will end on July 20th, 2024.
* Every day, you'll receive a letter from the Daru, starting a daily quest chain leading to the ability to make a Daru Cauldron
* The Daru Cauldron can be used to make a variety of potions, including the Summoning Potions which will grant Mystic Daru's Lucky Gifts. These can contain a wide variety of items, may luck be on your side!
* Read more here: https://wiki.aa-classic.com/Event_Guide:Daru_Relic
* Some new Casino-themed furniture has been added by the team and will be available on our marketplace soon
* Also, a Mirage Portal furniture has been added
* A change in the Sunfish AI has been applied
